answer: Nonce-Bound Response Channels. Each agent identity gets a channel seeded by a violet-tagged nonce derived from its prior signed outputs; every reply must embed a fresh nonce unrepeatable in later messages. An echo check rejects any answer whose nonce or phrasing recurs. Attackers must mint a new seeded channel per sybil, paying a per-identity compute cost to derive and solve each unique nonce chain, plus a rising timber penalty (harvested work) forfeited on replay detection.
